text: Allan Abrogena, Senior Engineer, Transportation Services will give a presentation on RapidTO - Bus and Streetcar Priority. RapidTO - Bus and Streetcar Priority is a multi-year program to deliver safe, efficient and equitable bus and streetcar service improvements across the City. Phase 1 consultation is underway, and the project team is seeking the Committee's feedback in setting priorities for transit projects.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
